claims.statement: App settings navigation depends on three indented reusable references for account settings, developer settings and GitHub Apps, followed by Edit next to the App name. Three-space indentation is render context; included procedures are separate review dependencies. Navigation does not prove ownership, role permission or any App modification.

The fragment navigates to an App settings page via an in-article anchor. The parent must supply the matching section; this fragment alone does not establish anchor resolution, supported account ownership type, current UI availability or authority to modify the App.
